request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: rowdy, ramshackle goblin raiders, primitive, loud and silly, never grim. Their fixed colours: deep true goblin green skin with a lot of bare skin showing; warm orange-brown leather loincloths, straps, harnesses, wrist wraps and small caps; weathered brown planks and pale rope; a little rusted iron and dark gunmetal scrap; home-made fireworks in grubby red, orange, yellow, blue and green paper with cream paper cones; near-black only in small details such as a belt or a round bomb; tiny red-orange fuse sparks. Leather is shaded dark red-brown, skin with darker green.
layers.negative: gun, rifle, pistol, musket, cannon, modern car, rubber tyres, chrome, headlights, neon, glowing green, lime green, cyan glow, purple magic glow, skull, bones, blood, gore, horror, black armour, black clothes, black leather coat, red tunic, yellow tunic, yellow clothes, gold armour, steel missile, warhead, jet engine

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute unit figure with a big head, short sturdy body and one oversized signature weapon or tool, thick single-colour black outline, standing ready pose, both feet visible; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
layers.negative: pedestal, base, plinth, round base, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, stand, terrain slab, dirt slab, grass square, stone block under the subject, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, cast shadow on the ground, multiple units, crowd

layers.text: Subject: Rocket Cart, a chunky cute rickety goblin fireworks cart, clearly bigger than a soldier but narrow and compact: a small crooked hand cart of weathered brown planks on two wobbly wooden wheels, loaded with a tight bundle of five home-made fireworks rockets of different sizes standing up on thin wooden sticks and leaning forward, tied together with pale rope: fat paper tubes in grubby red, orange, yellow, one blue and one green, each with a pointed cream paper cone on top and a short curly fuse, one fuse lit with a small red-orange spark; a tiny goblin with deep green skin, long pointed ears and an orange-brown leather loincloth and cap stands close behind the cart holding a burning match; simple shapes and very few details; the wheels are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a cart of fireworks about to go off, not a missile and not a catapult.

layers.negative: missile, steel missile, tail fins, warhead, jet engine, catapult arm, bucket, horse, smoke trail, explosion, one single giant rocket
